title: Ethiopian Chicken Tikka Masala
description: A twist on the classic Indian dish, inspired by Ethiopian flavors.

ingredients.name: Ethiopian berbere spice mix (or regular berbere mix)
fettuccine
ingredients.notes: or substitute with other pasta of your choice

ingredients.name: kik alicha spice mix (or regular alicha spice mix)
zesty yogurt
ingredients.notes: plain yogurt with a squeeze of lemon

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add mirepoix mix and cook until softened.
Add chicken and cook until browned.
Add berbere spice mix, alicha spice mix, and yogurt.
Stir well and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in jammy tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve over fettuccine and garnish with additional yogurt and spice mix if desired.
